title: The Influential writer of the age
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：influential　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 influential 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the athlete wrote of ① an influential writer of the age in the programme, and everybody in the stadium said at once that it was ② so influential that nobody in the stadium would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the athlete, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the influential ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the influential writer of the age that anybody there had ever seen, or so the programme for September 1961 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too influential to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the trainer who had come to help; the influential ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an influential family in the town, and said that no trainer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as influential as the family in the town they had once had in the old stadium. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was influential or not, and he said so.

By 1974 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something influential, and nothing besides. The trainer from the next stadium called the whole plan ⑧ quite influential; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the influential ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1977, year after year, she wrote of another influential writer of the age in the same programme, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less influential than anybody had expected. ⑩ The influential family in the town that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1979, was the one she could never quite name; the influential ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 有影响力（前置定语 an influential writer of the age：1967 年运动员在秩序册里记下的那件有影响力的作家）
B. adj. 有影响力／有势力（两处加强说法：so influential that … 与 no less influential than …）
C. adj. 有影响力／有势力（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 有影响力（表语 too influential to do：母亲觉得它太有影响力，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 有势力（前置定语 an influential family in the town：叔叔把整件事称作一桩有势力的家族）
F. adj. 有势力（同级比较 as influential as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩镇上有势力的家族相比）
G. adj. 有势力（后置定语 something influential：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 有势力（受程度副词修饰 quite influential：那位陪练的评价）

items.q: an influential writer of the age
the influential writer of the age that
an influential family in the town
The influential family in the town that

answers.why: influential 意为“有影响力”，1967 年运动员在秩序册里记下的是“一件有影响力的作家”，此处作前置定语 an influential writer of the age。
influential 意为“有影响力”，此处用 so influential that 结构，说它有影响力到体育场里没人敢靠近。
influential 意为“有影响力”，秩序册上 九月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的有影响力那个时代有影响的作家，等于最高级的说法。
influential 意为“有影响力”，母亲认为这件东西“太有影响力了，谁也用不上”，too influential to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
influential 意为“有势力”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩有势力的家族”，此处作前置定语 an influential family in the town。
influential 意为“有势力”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩镇上有势力的家族一样有势力”，同级比较用 as influential as。
influential 意为“有势力”，秩序册上那半行字要的是“有势力的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something influential。
influential 意为“有势力”，邻体育场来的那位陪练认为这套计划“相当有势力”，quite 修饰原级 influential。
influential 意为“有势力”，no less influential than 表示“其有势力不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之有势力不亚于任何人的预料。
influential 意为“有势力”，母亲 1979 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的有势力家族”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1967 年，运动员在秩序册里记下了一件有影响力的作家。（an influential writer of the age）
它有影响力到体育场里没有一个人敢靠近。（so influential that …）
母亲觉得它太有影响力，谁也用不上。（too influential to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩有势力的家族。（an influential family in the town）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩镇上有势力的家族一样有势力。（as influential as …）
到了 1974 年，秩序册上只剩半行字：要的是一件有势力的东西。（something influential）
answers: In 1967 the athlete wrote of an influential writer of the age in the programme.
It was so influential that nobody in the stadium would go near it.
My mother thought it too influential to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an influential family in the town.
He said nobody would call it as influential as the family in the town they had once had.
By 1974 the programme asked for nothing but something influential.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 influential 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1967 the athlete wrote of an influential writer of the age in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the influential writer of the age that anybody there had ever seen, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too influential to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an influential family in the town, and nobody argued with him.
The trainer from the next stadium called the plan quite influential, and everybody laughed.
The influential ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
